svg.title: Kubernetes packet paths
svg.desc: Each row shows one forward path between representative workers.

g.text: Each row shows one forward path between representative workers.
Cilium VXLAN runs inside the Tailscale underlay.
Both Pods stay on one worker.
Same-node delivery does not use VXLAN or Tailscale.
Cilium translates the virtual address to a backend Pod.
NodePort: tailnet client to 100.x:NodePort on tailscale0, then an eBPF backend lookup.
The worker translates the source address on eth0.
Cilium owns Pod and Service routing; Tailscale carries the node underlay.
